description: We are JUGRE, a team of young innovators passionate about space, technology, artificial intelligence, and solving real-world problems. We aim to combine creativity, coding, and scientific thinking to build impactful solutions at the NASA Space Apps Challenge. We welcome motivated developers, designers, researchers, and creative thinkers who enjoy teamwork, innovation, and turning ambitious ideas into reality. Let's build something extraordinary together!
summary:
JUGRE SPACE PROJECT is an interactive 3D space construction and mission simulator that turns the complexity of spaceflight into a hands-on learning experience. We built a virtual hangar where users assemble rockets from compatible parts, select payloads, and explore how design choices affect a mission.

Users can create their own missions or experience scenarios inspired by Apollo 11, Artemis II, Mars 2020, DART, Voyager 2, and International Space Station resupply. They can prepare a launch, follow telemetry, control ascent, and observe events such as staging, spacecraft deployment, lunar flight, and planetary encounters. Standard and Engineering modes provide different levels of detail, from guided planning to deeper design and resource decisions.

The simulator combines flight calculations with guided sequences, making concepts such as thrust, fuel consumption, gravity, orbital motion, and mission constraints visible and engaging. Its offline design lets users explore without a server or internet connection.

JUGRE addresses the challenge of making space science and engineering accessible to more learners through active experimentation. By connecting spacecraft design with the consequences of flight, it encourages curiosity, problem solving, and a deeper appreciation of the people, technology, and choices behind space exploration.
